== Published English Original Virtual Set 3 wording ==
The original allows the player to decide whether to capture after a successful draw. The later text makes the capture automatic once the optional destiny draw exceeds the card’s destiny number. The kinds of forfeited cards, location requirement, Imperial capital starship and Alter immunity remain.
